1\. Old overrides evade wrapping 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
__init_subclass__ now treats any second parameter as the new context parameter, so legacy
overrides such as process_response(self, response) are not wrapped. Flask then calls them as
process_response(ctx, response), raising TypeError during response finalization; exception,
finalize, logging, and teardown overrides with legacy parameters are similarly affected.
